html:
Given objects containing name and integer score, return them in descending score order, preserving original order for equal scores.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      {
        "name": "N",
        "score": 7
      },
      {
        "name": "M",
        "score": 9
      },
      {
        "name": "P",
        "score": 7
      }
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    {
      "name": "M",
      "score": 9
    },
    {
      "name": "N",
      "score": 7
    },
    {
      "name": "P",
      "score": 7
    }
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Python sorting is stable.

Complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: stable-record-sort.py
solutions.code:
def solve(records):
    return sorted(records, key=lambda row: -row['score'])
